newsitem.title: MEXICO: RESEARCH ALERT - Apasco started as hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Apasco started as hold.

text.p: Afin Securities Mexico City analyst Carlos Pena said on Friday the brokerage began coverage of Mexican cement company Apasco with a hold recommendation.
"Pricing pressures in the Mexican cement market could continue to affect Apasco's operating results negatively during the first half of the year," he wrote in a report.
He said the company's financial structure is solid, with leverage of 33.5 percent and debt carrying interest rates as low as 8.5 percent.
Mexico's second largest cement producer has cash holdings of $152 million, Pena added, saying the amount could hint at a strategic investment.
Afin estimates earnings per share for Apasco of 3.14 pesos for 1997 and 4.38 pesos for 1998.
Apasco's Mexican shares closed trading on Thursday at 51.9 pesos each. The company's shares in New York last traded on Tuesday at 34 1/2.
